retired_workflow_dispatch_entrypoints.reason: Retired after its test-only repair was merged by PR #823.

Removed the caller-selectable manual trigger because this privileged workflow is defined and verified as a PR-time certification check; no supported manual-dispatch use was identified. inventory_scope: All active workflow_dispatch paths in this candidate checkout. classification_schema.purpose_class_rule: Classify by primary workflow purpose. Task intake means YAML accepts/submits substantive work requests; validation/diagnostic means it primarily checks code or evidence; certification/research means it primarily runs research evaluation or certification. Effects such as artifact generation never determine purpose class.
classification_schema.effect_status_rule: NOT_DECLARED_IN_YAML records only that this YAML scan found no declaration; it never proves absence, safety, or read-only behavior. UNKNOWN preserves behavior not provable from YAML, including invoked-code behavior and effective permissions.
classification_schema.hash_binding: source_evidence.workflow_sha256 is SHA-256 over exact workflow bytes; line references and effect values are mechanically checked against those bytes.
classification_schema.human_attestation: No natural-person identity or human approval is authenticated by this inventory. REVIEWED reflects the Product Owner accepted purpose mapping, not authenticated human signoff.

A committed local work item hash protects content integrity only; it does not authenticate author, reviewer role, caller identity, or human approval.
All 17 active GitHub workflow_dispatch entrypoints remain UNSATISFIED for pre-work admission and are not intercepted before dispatch.

Purpose and effects are independent. NOT_DECLARED_IN_YAML is not proof of absent effects or safety; invoked scripts, actions, platform behavior, effective permissions, and undeclared side effects may remain UNKNOWN.
Workflow hashes and line evidence bind observations to workflow content but do not authenticate a human reviewer or establish scientific validity.
Universal task intake, branch protection, workflow dispatch trust, and authenticated human approval remain UNSATISFIED.

Frozen-head trusted evidence coverage is scoped to pull requests targeting main, the only target branch whose protection was read back; no trusted certification coverage is established for PRs to other target branches.
